info.title: Clash Detection
info.description: The Clash Detection API allows you to manage clash detection suppression rules, tests, runs, reports, and manual suppressions.

get.description:
---

Retrieves manual suppressions for the specified clash detection report.

- Discover clash report ids by calling [GET /clash-detection/itwins/{itwinId}/reports](/apis/clash-detection-v2/operations/get-clash-detection-reports/)

### Authentication

Requires `Authorization` header with valid Bearer token for scope `itwin-platform`.

For more documentation on authorization and how to get access token visit [OAUTH2 Authorization](https://developer.bentley.com/apis/overview/authorization/) page.

---

parameters.name: clashReportId
parameters.description: Clash report id (result id) for which the manual suppression should be retrieved.

parameters.name: $top
parameters.description: Returns number of items mentioned. Maximum page size is 100, default is 10. E.g. top=1 will return only first item from the collection.

parameters.name: $skip
parameters.description: Number of items that are to be skipped and not included in the result, default value is 0. E.g. skip=2 will return items from the collection starting at the third place.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: It allows sorting of createdAt. Allowed values are ASC OR DESC. Default value is DESC

parameters.name: elementAId
parameters.description: Allows to filter suppression data with the given element A id.

parameters.name: elementBId
parameters.description: Allows to filter suppression data with the given element B id.

parameters.name: suppressionType
parameters.description: Allows to filter suppression data with the given type. unsuppress = 0, suppress = 1.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Allows to filter suppression data with the given user id.

parameters.name: includeUserMetadata
parameters.description: If set to true, response will include user metadata information. Default value is false.

post.description:
---

Runs clash detection tests for the specified job ids (test ids) [currently restricted to one test run per request] and returns the clash report ids. The maximum number of clashes can be specified with the resultsLimit parameter in the request body. If none is specified, the default is 100,000.

- This API has a rate limit of 6 API calls per second. If an application exceeds the rate limit it will receive an HTTP error code 429 "Too Many Requests". The error response includes a Retry-After header that indicates how long clients should wait before retrying.

- To retrieve the run status as the agent job completes asynchronously, use the clash report id to call [GET /clash-detection/itwins/{itwinId}/reports/{id}](/apis/clash-detection-v2/operations/get-clash-detection-report/)

- Discover test ids by calling [GET /clash-detection/itwins/{itwinId}/tests](/apis/clash-detection-v2/operations/get-clash-detection-tests/)

- Discover iModel ids by calling [GET /imodels/?iTwinId](/apis/imodels-v2/operations/get-itwins-imodels/)

- Discover changeset ids by calling [GET /imodels/{id}/changesets](/apis/imodels-v2/operations/get-imodel-changesets/)

### Authentication

Requires `Authorization` header with valid Bearer token for scope `itwin-platform`.

For more documentation on authorization and how to get access token visit [OAUTH2 Authorization](https://developer.bentley.com/apis/overview/authorization/) page.

---

parameters.description: False: create new clash results in subsequent runs for the combination of TestId, iModelId and namedVersionId; True: update the existing clash results in subsequent runs for the combination of TestId, iModelId and namedVersionId; Force: run the clash test on same combination.

Cancel the clash detection runs for the specified job ids (clash report ids) of the respective iTwin.

- Note: At present, only one run using clash report id can be cancelled at a time.
